name: Allosaurus
originOfName: Means 'different lizard' in Greek.
globalPresence: Fossils have been found mainly in North America and Europe.
description: A large carnivorous theropod known for its powerful jaws, sharp teeth, and distinctive horns above its eyes.

name: Alvarezsaurus
originOfName: Named after historian and paleontologist Gregorio Álvarez.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered in Argentina and other parts of South America.
description: A small, lightly built dinosaur with unusually short arms and a single large claw on each hand.

name: Archaeopteryx
originOfName: Means 'ancient wing' in Greek.
globalPresence: Known from fossil specimens discovered in Germany.
description: An early bird-like dinosaur famous for having both feathers and reptilian features, making it important in the study of bird evolution.

name: Brachiosaurus
originOfName: Means 'arm lizard' in Greek, referring to its unusually long forelimbs.
globalPresence: Fossils have been found in North America and Africa.
description: A massive long-necked herbivore recognized for its tall shoulders, long neck, and towering body.

name: Coelophysis
originOfName: Means 'hollow form' in Greek, referring to its hollow bones.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered primarily in the United States.
description: A small and slender early theropod that lived in groups and was adapted for fast movement.

name: Dilophosaurus
originOfName: Means 'two-crested lizard' in Greek, referring to the two crests on its skull.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered in Arizona, United States.
description: A large early theropod recognized by its two rounded skull crests and slender body built for active movement.

name: Eoraptor
originOfName: Means 'dawn plunderer' in Greek.
globalPresence: Fossils are known from Argentina.
description: One of the earliest known dinosaurs, Eoraptor was a small and agile animal with a varied diet.

name: Gallimimus
originOfName: Means 'chicken mimic' in Greek, referring to its bird-like appearance.
globalPresence: Fossils have been found in Mongolia.
description: A fast-running dinosaur with a long neck, small head, and bird-like body adapted for speed.

name: Herrerasaurus
originOfName: Named after Victorino Herrera, who discovered the first specimen.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered in Argentina.
description: A slender early carnivorous dinosaur and one of the earliest known members of the dinosaur lineage.

name: Mononykus
originOfName: Means 'one claw' in Greek, referring to its single large claw on each hand.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered in Mongolia.
description: A small, bird-like dinosaur with extremely short arms and a single large claw on each hand, adapted for a specialized lifestyle.

name: Nigersaurus
originOfName: Named after Niger, the country where its fossils were discovered.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered in Niger, Africa.
description: A long-necked herbivore with a wide, shovel-shaped mouth containing hundreds of small teeth.

name: Pachycephalosaurus
originOfName: Means 'thick-headed lizard' in Greek, referring to its thick domed skull.
globalPresence: Fossils have been found mainly in Montana, Wyoming, and South Dakota.
description: A bipedal dinosaur famous for its thick, domed skull and bony knobs around the back of its head.

name: Parasaurolophus
originOfName: Means 'near crested lizard' in Greek, referring to its resemblance to Saurolophus.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered in Canada and the United States.
description: A duck-billed dinosaur recognized by its long, backward-curving crest, which may have helped produce sounds and regulate body temperature.

name: Plateosaurus
originOfName: Means 'broad lizard' in Greek.
globalPresence: Fossils have been found across several parts of Europe.
description: A large early herbivorous dinosaur that could walk on two or four legs and had a long neck and tail.

name: Pterodactylus
originOfName: Means 'winged finger' in Greek, referring to the elongated finger supporting its wing.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered mainly in Germany.
description: A small flying reptile with a long, pointed beak, wings supported by an elongated finger, and a lightweight body.

name: Quetzalcoatlus
originOfName: Named after Quetzalcoatl, the feathered serpent deity of Mesoamerican mythology.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered in Texas, United States.
description: One of the largest known flying animals, with an enormous wingspan, long neck, and lightweight body.

name: Spinosaurus
originOfName: Means 'spine lizard' in Latin and Greek, referring to its tall neural spines.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered in Egypt, Morocco, and other parts of North Africa.
description: A huge predatory dinosaur recognized by its elongated snout, conical teeth, and tall sail-like spine.

name: Stegosaurus
originOfName: Means 'roof lizard' in Greek, referring to its large back plates.
globalPresence: Fossils have been found primarily in western North America.
description: A heavily built herbivore known for its large back plates and four long spikes at the end of its tail.

name: Styracosaurus
originOfName: Means 'spiked lizard' in Greek, referring to the long horns on its frill.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered mainly in Alberta, Canada.
description: A horned dinosaur with a large frill, one prominent nose horn, and several long spikes around the edge of its frill.

name: Triceratops
originOfName: Means 'three-horned face' in Greek.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered across western North America.
description: A large horned herbivore with three facial horns and a broad protective frill.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
originOfName: Means 'tyrant lizard king' in Greek and Latin.
globalPresence: Fossils have been found mainly in the western United States and Canada.
description: One of the most famous predatory dinosaurs, known for its massive skull, powerful jaws, and large teeth.

name: Velociraptor
originOfName: Means 'swift seizer' in Latin.
globalPresence: Fossils have been discovered primarily in Mongolia.
description: A small, agile predator known for its sickle-shaped claw on each foot and lightweight body.
